sources.title: Freight brokerage software sizing
sources.snippet: Freight brokerage and load-matching software is estimated at $9-12B in 2026, growing 12-15%. The category is fragmented with many regional players.

sources.title: Incumbent load boards
sources.snippet: DAT and Truckstop.com are the established load boards and hold most carrier relationships. Both have shipped matching automation in the last three years.
